FCP-02.implementation: External card drafts register actor/project/board/card identity. Access refusal/session scope change/logout erases clean canonical base/draft fields, preserves only fieldwise changed unsent values (including empty strings) and original unresolved commands. Query-cache observer reacts only to actual error actions, avoiding observer-render notification loops. Fresh canonical props/remount restores clean fields; redaction alone never refills from stale props. Session transitions target the prior actor or changed/removed prior project rows; adding unrelated project C preserves authorized forms A/B. Current role/archive session-summary changes trigger restoration from the fresh canonical summary.
